Hi families,

Today's dinner discussion could be about how some people protect their money from big drops in the price of things like Bitcoin. It’s interesting to talk about why they choose certain strategies.

A simple claim to test could be: "If we save $5 from our weekly allowance or spending money this week, can we buy something better next week?" It’s a fun way to see how saving pays off.

Wishing you a warm evening full of happy chats!

Warmly,
[Your Name]
